params.initialRate: Exchange rate (outputToken units per 1e6 inputToken units, 6-decimal scale).                    Set to 1e6 for a 1:1 mock rate when both tokens use 6 decimals.
params.outputToken_: Address of the ERC-20 token to produce as swap output.

executeSwap((uint256,address,address,add.details: For the mock: the caller must have approved this contract to pull inputToken,      OR must have already transferred inputAmount to this contract.      The mock computes output = inputAmount * mockExchangeRate / 1e6      and transfers outputToken from its own balance to params.receiver.      This contract must hold sufficient outputToken balance for tests.

returns.result: Detailed result of the swap execution.

params._shouldFail: True to make all swaps fail.

executeSwap((uint256,address,address,add.notice: Executes a token swap according to the provided parameters.

mockExchangeRate().notice: Simulated exchange rate: outputToken units per 1e6 inputToken units.         e.g. 1e18 means 1:1 (same decimals), 2e6 means 2 outputToken per 1 inputToken (6 decimals).

outputToken().notice: The ERC-20 token this executor produces as swap output.

owner().notice: Owner of this mock — can update rate and failure mode.

shouldFail().notice: If true, every executeSwap call reverts (tests failure handling).
